items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Terminology 121:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Tzadik that comes out of her? The Yesod of the male is the aspect of the bearer of the Upper Light, called the direct light, and it is called the Tzadik that enters her, meaning the one that brings the Upper Light into the Nukva, and it is also called by the name Joseph. And the aspect of the screen in the Yesod of the Nukva, upon which the Upper Light strikes, since the screen pushes back and returns the Upper Light behind it, is discerned as the Tzadik that comes out of her, meaning that the Upper Light comes out and is pushed out from it, because it does not allow it to clothe within it; and with this strike it raises the returning light, which clothes and sustains the direct light, as is known. And it is also called by the name Benjamin. (Item 71).
